walkthroughs.body_html: Speed = distance ÷ time. A runner covers 30 m in 4 s. Speed = 30 ÷ 4 = 7.5 m/s. Used to rank sprinters and assess progression.
Football — agility, coordination, CV endurance. Gymnastics — flexibility, balance, power. 100 m sprint — power, speed, reaction time. Long-distance running — CV endurance, muscular endurance.

The bleep test is maximal — motivation affects results. Sit-and-reach measures hamstring + lower back, not whole-body flexibility. Use multiple tests and re-test under same conditions to track progress fairly.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between strength and power?
options: Strength is maximum force; power is force times speed of movement.
Strength is for the upper body, power for the lower.
Speed.
They are the same thing.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between aerobic and muscular endurance?
options: Aerobic endurance is the cardiovascular system's ability to supply oxygen; muscular endurance is a muscle's ability to contract repeatedly without fatigue.
Aerobic is for legs, muscular for arms.
Speed.
They are different names for the same component.
